summary: Verified gpt-5.4-mini perf fix, rotating loading messages, glowing Connect With Me mailto button, and phone-gated PDF download. Backend 6/6 pytest pass; frontend E2E all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handlers.
generate_roadmap catches broad Exception -> 502; more granular handling (rate-limit / auth / JSON parse) would improve UX.
Frontend silently falls back to TEMPLATE on API error - user only sees badge change; consider a subtle toast.
test_roadmap.py has a hardcoded fallback URL; should also raise KeyError like new perf test to avoid stale defaults.
seed_data_creation: Lead rows inserted for 9876543210 via /api/leads (test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf test parametrized over 3 skills, asserts <=12s and structure. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported and `-o 'addopts='` to bypass xdist worker isolation issues. Frontend Playwright validated: connect-btn mailto + glow (box-shadow + connectGlow animation), rotating loading msg ('Analyzing your skill...' at t=0.5s), result-mode='AI-POWERED', 4 phase cards, phone-error shake on '12345', valid 9876543210 -> PDF 'excel-30-day-roadmap.pdf' downloaded and localStorage mr_phone set.
